title: Who is who in On the Face of It
back: Derry (burnt face, bitterness → hope), Mr Lamb (tin leg, open gate, cheerful by choice), Derry's mother (forbids, is defied).

title: The play in six beats
back: Over the wall → bitterness → Lamb's answers → a promise → Scene 2 → the ladder.

title: One side burnt by acid
svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 320 200" role="img" aria-label="Stares, whispers, and a kiss on the other side" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" font-size="11"><circle cx="160" cy="95" r="55" fill="currentColor" fill-opacity="0.85" stroke="none"/><path d="M160,40 A55,55 0 0 1 160,150 Z" fill="#E0B400" fill-opacity="0.6" stroke="none"/><text x="160" y="185" text-anchor="middle" font-size="10" font-style="italic" fill="currentColor" stroke="none">only a mother could love…</text><text x="160.0" y="192" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" font-style="italic" fill="currentColor" fill-opacity="0.85" stroke="none">Stares, whispers, and a kiss on the other side</text></svg>
back: Derry reads every reaction as rejection — even his mother's affection. He hates pity, comparisons and Beauty and the Beast.

title: No weeds, only growing things
svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 320 200" role="img" aria-label="Labels like ugly and beautiful are choices" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" font-size="11"><g><rect x="86.0" y="120.0" width="8.0" height="50.0" fill="currentColor" fill-opacity="0.6" stroke="none"/><circle cx="90" cy="100.0" r="30.0" fill="currentColor" fill-opacity="0.6" stroke="none"/><circle cx="72.0" cy="115.0" r="20.0" fill="currentColor" fill-opacity="0.6" stroke="none"/><circle cx="108.0" cy="115.0" r="20.0" fill="currentColor" fill-opacity="0.6" stroke="none"/></g><g><path d="M180,170 V140" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/><circle cx="180" cy="136" r="8" fill="#E0B400" stroke="none"/></g><g><path d="M215,170 V134" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/><circle cx="215" cy="130" r="8" fill="#E0B400" stroke="none"/></g><g><path d="M250,170 V128" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/><circle cx="250" cy="124" r="8" fill="#E0B400" stroke="none"/></g><g><path d="M285,170 V122" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/><circle cx="285" cy="118" r="8" fill="#E0B400" stroke="none"/></g><text x="160" y="40" text-anchor="middle" font-size="9" font-style="italic" fill="currentColor" stroke="none">a weed is a flower someone decided not to like</text><text x="160.0" y="192" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" font-style="italic" fill="currentColor" fill-opacity="0.85" stroke="none">Labels like ugly and beautiful are choices</text></svg>
back: Mr Lamb refuses to divide plants — or people. The same goes for bees that sing rather than buzz: attitude decides.

title: The man who locked himself in
svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 320 200" role="img" aria-label="Afraid of everything — killed by a falling picture" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" font-size="11"><rect x="60" y="40" width="200" height="130" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="5"/><rect x="120" y="60" width="60" height="44" fill="currentColor" fill-opacity="0.85" stroke="none"/><path d="M150,108 L150,135 M145.2,126.2 L150,135 L154.8,126.2" fill="none" stroke="#E0B400" stroke-width="4" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/><g><circle cx="150" cy="114.6" r="6.6" fill="currentColor" fill-opacity="0.9" stroke="none"/><path d="M141.0,129.2 Q150,121.19999999999999 159.0,129.2 L157.2,145.2 H169.8 V152.4 H167.1 V168 H163.5 V154.8 H141.9 Z" fill="currentColor" fill-opacity="0.9" stroke="none"/></g><text x="160.0" y="192" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" font-style="italic" fill="currentColor" fill-opacity="0.85" stroke="none">Afraid of everything — killed by a falling picture</text></svg>
back: Hiding from life does not make you safe; it only leaves you alone. The story is Mr Lamb's answer to Derry's wish to be alone.

title: Hatred burns worse than acid

back: Acid burnt the face once; hatred of the people who stare would go on burning the self. Everyone has something — a tin leg, a burnt face, a fear of the dark.

title: Derry to his mother
svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 320 200" role="img" aria-label="Line to remember" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" font-size="11"><g><rect x="28" y="36" width="264" height="72" fill="currentColor" fill-opacity="0.08" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" rx="10"/><path d="M50,108 L42,122 L64,108 Z" fill="currentColor" fill-opacity="0.9" stroke="none"/><text x="160.0" y="76.9" text-anchor="middle" font-size="14" font-weight="700" fill="currentColor" stroke="none">what I look like isn't important</text></g><text x="160" y="146" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" fill="currentColor" fill-opacity="0.8" stroke="none">— before he runs three miles back</text><text x="160.0" y="192" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" font-style="italic" fill="currentColor" fill-opacity="0.85" stroke="none">Line to remember</text></svg>
back: The reversal of Scene 1: he wants to be with people and do things; if he does not go now he will never go anywhere.
